## 1500 W Wilson Ave — Zoning & Development Analysis
**PIN: 14171060250000 | Uptown (Community Area 3)**

---

### 1. Zoning District

This parcel is zoned **B1-2** (Neighborhood Shopping District, bulk/density tier 2), confirmed from the City's official GIS system. Verify at the [Chicago Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning).

---

### 2. Residential Uses: Above-Ground-Floor & Ground-Floor Apartments

**Above ground floor:** The B1 district allows residential dwelling units **on or above the ground floor** — this is explicitly permitted [1] for the B2 district. However, B1 is more restrictive: the retrieved code text addresses B2 and B3 in detail, and B1 typically limits residential to above the ground floor only, but the precise B1 residential permission language was **not in the retrieved code sections**. Based on standard Chicago zoning practice, residential above ground-floor commercial is generally permitted in B1 districts, but you should confirm the specific B1 use table with the Department of Planning and Development (DPD).

**Ground-floor residential:** Ground-floor dwelling units in B districts are generally **not permitted as of right**. [1] describes B2 as permitting residential "on or above the ground floor," implying ground-floor retail is the default at grade. The code explicitly restricts newly established detached houses and two-flats in transit-served B/C districts [5], and B3 permits residential "above the ground floor" [1]. Ground-floor apartments in a B1-2 district are not supported by the retrieved text — treat this as not permitted without a zoning variation.

> **Verify:** Contact DPD Zoning at (312) 744-5777 or review the B1 use table at Chicago Municipal Code [§ 17-3-0200](https://www.chicago.gov/city/en/depts/dcd/supp_info/chicago_zoning_ordinance.html).

---

### 3. Bulk & Density Standards

The retrieved code sections do not include the specific B1-2 bulk standards table (FAR, height, minimum lot area per unit, setbacks). Here is what the code and context confirm:

- **Density tier:** The "-2" suffix refers to a bulk/density tier; B districts combine base district with dash designations [1] — B1-2 is a mid-density tier.
- **FAR increase for transit-served locations:** Available only in **B-3 and C-3 dash districts** [4] through a Type 1 Map Amendment, Planned Development, or ARO entitlement — **not applicable to B1-2 by right.**
- **Open space:** Not governed by the B1 residential sections in retrieved text; RM district standards [2] and Downtown standards [3] were retrieved but do not directly apply here.

**What I could not determine:** The specific FAR cap, maximum height, minimum lot area per dwelling unit, and setback requirements for B1-2 are **not in the retrieved code text**. These are in the B-district bulk standards table at [4] (§ 17-3-0403 and related sections).

> **Verify:** [§ 17-3-0400](https://library.municode.com/il/chicago/codes/code_of_ordinances) bulk table for B1-2; also request a zoning determination letter from DPD.

---

### 4. Overlays & Special Designations

| **Landmark / Historic District** | ❌ No | No landmark review |

---

### 5. Parking Requirement & Transit Reduction

This parcel qualifies for a **transit-served location** parking reduction. Under [4] and per [§ 17-10-0102-B], the minimum parking requirement can be **reduced by up to 100%** — meaning zero parking is required as of right for development here. This applies because the parcel is within 2,640 feet of a CTA rail station entrance [5]. The nearest CTA rail is **Montrose (Brown Line), 0.45 miles away**, and the nearest Metra is **Ravenswood (Union Pacific North), 0.39 miles away**.

> No density, FAR, or height bonus accompanies this parking relief at B1-2 — those bonuses apply only in dash-3 districts [4].

---

### 6. Maximum Height, FAR, Transit Density Bonuses

- **FAR and height for B1-2:** The specific numeric limits are **not in the retrieved code text** — see [4] (§ 17-3-0403) bulk standards table.
- **Transit FAR bonus:** Available **only in B-3 and C-3 dash districts** [4], and only through a Type 1 Map Amendment, Planned Development, or ARO entitlement. **This parcel at B1-2 does not qualify for a FAR bonus by right.**
- **Density bonus:** Also not available at B1-2 — `density_bonus_eligible` is false for this district. No density, FAR, or height bonus applies here [4].
- **What transit does change:** You can eliminate the parking minimum entirely under [§ 17-10-0102-B], which is significant for a mixed-use project on a 4,347 sq ft lot.

> **How to verify:** Pull the full § 17-3-0400 bulk standards table from the [Chicago Municipal Code](https://library.municode.com/il/chicago/codes/code_of_ordinances) or request a Pre-Application Conference with DPD.

---

### Additional Context

- **TIF District:** Clark/Montrose TIF (expires 2035) — TIF increment financing may be available; current fund balance is ~$14M. Active projects include the Black Ensemble Studio Theater and an SBIF small business program.
- **Property:** Built 1964, 43,790 sq ft building on a 4,347 sq ft lot (1-story commercial). Estimated annual property tax: **~$15,960**, primarily to Chicago Public Schools ($8,539), City of Chicago ($3,798), and Cook County ($918). Standard tax class — no incentive reduction.
- **Walkability:** Walk Score 95/100 (Walker's Paradise), Transit Score 81/100 (Excellent Transit), Bike Score 91/100 (Biker's Paradise).
